tagline: International Association representing the interests of inland shipping, insurance and ship survey across Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: The association successfully hosted its 2024 annual congress in Frankfurt, welcoming 225 participants from 11 different European countries. This event represents the highlight of the year and demonstrates the ongoing commitment of members and partners in the European inland navigation sector.

kpis.description: IVR organized its annual congress on May 15-17, 2024 in Frankfurt, attracting 225 participants from 11 European countries. The event featured workshops on navigating the future of inland waterways, addressing themes of safety culture, decarbonization, and sustainability in European inland shipping.

IVR successfully launched its first Loss Prevention Colloquium on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, Belgium, with approximately 80 participants from the insurance, brokerage, and maritime sectors. The event covered technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
